files.name: motion-prompt-045.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Wipe" (ワイプ), one of the names in "Camera moves & transitions".
Motion Prompt #045

What it is: A moving edge replaces the shot
What the sample shows: A vertical edge moves from left to right and the next picture replaces the current one behind it.
Spec:
- Join: 1.1 s, from 1.7 s to 2.8 s; the edge travels from just outside the left side (x = -4 px) to just outside the right side (x = 543 px)
- Easing: cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
- The incoming picture shows left of the edge and the outgoing one right of it; neither picture moves (a reveal by clipping, not a push)
- Edge: a 4 px blue vertical line, visible only while it is moving
- Camera: fixed in both pictures; the subjects do not move either
- Alternates A→B and B→A every 4.7 s (9.4 s for the round trip); top-right readout shows "A → B" / "B → A"
When to use it: To mark a clear change of scene or topic, or to switch between the two sides of a comparison.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/045.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/camera.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
